title: CLO has changed the overall design environment of Adidas.
transcript:
I completely fell in love with 3D. I think 3D is an amazing tool. Of course, it is easier and clearer to understand a 3D drawing than a flat 2D sketch.  
It gives me a great visual when I need to sell something or when I communicate with other Business Units. It really shows what the product will look like in the store.  
The great thing about using 3D is that there is no miscommunication between the parties because the 3D drawing is actually a very accurate representation of the final result.  
The 3D modeling, texturing, and styling are amazing. It is very close to reality.  
It is a way to collaborate more with other departments. Going from hand sketching directly into pattern making and then into 3D helps a lot in making everyone understand.  
Yes, I think it is great to start designing on a 3D surface. That way, you can examine all the different angles in order to shape your ideas into real-life proportions.  
We also updated some patterns in 3D because we could visualize what would be the best solution.  
We also prepared some presentations where we used 3D to explain some pattern issues or problems to our marketing colleagues.  
3D modeling software is helping our design process to create more conscious and realistic designs.  
For me, 3D is definitely about visualization and the quicker we can get marketing to understand the sketches and all the upfront work straight into development, the better. It really saves time.  
There is good understanding between the designer and me, and I think it is also a positive aspect when we talk to the Line Owner and the factory team.  
The design process is automatically changing.  
You can make decisions much faster, and you work closely together.

chunks.content: ## Impact of 3D Technology on Adidas Design Environment This section covers the integration of 3D technology in Adidas's design workflow, emphasizing its role in visualization, communication, and collaboration across departments. I completely fell in love with 3D technology as an amazing tool in design. Unlike flat 2D sketches, 3D drawings provide a clearer and easier way to understand designs by offering a realistic visual representation of the final product. This capability is especially valuable when presenting concepts or communicating with other Business Units, as the 3D model closely reflects what the product will look like in stores. The precision of 3D modeling, texturing, and styling is very close to reality, which significantly reduces miscommunication between parties. It allows for more effective collaboration across departments by streamlining the transition from hand sketching to pattern making and then into 3D visualization. Designing directly on a 3D surface enables examination of ideas from all angles, helping to shape concepts into real-life proportions. By updating patterns in 3D, the team can visualize and identify the best solutions before physical prototyping. This approach also supports presentations where 3D models explain pattern issues or challenges to marketing colleagues, enhancing overall understanding and decision-making. 3D modeling software contributes to creating more conscious and realistic designs, accelerating the process by enabling quicker comprehension from marketing to development. This improved collaboration fosters better alignment between designers, line owners, and factory teams, allowing faster decision-making and a more integrated design process. Overall, 3D technology is transforming the Adidas design environment by improving visualization, communication, and efficiency across multiple teams.
